apiVersion: v2
name: flask-microservice
description: A Helm chart for deploying a Python Flask microservice
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
keywords:
  - flask
  - python
  - microservice
home: https://github.com/example/flask-microservice
maintainers:
  - name: DevOps Team
    email: devops@example.com
# This chart requires the Prometheus Operator for ServiceMonitor
dependencies:
  - name: prometheus-community/prometheus-operator
    version: ">=45.0.0"
    condition: serviceMonitor.enabled
    repository: https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts

---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for flask-microservice.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 1

image:
  repository: my-flask-app
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
  tag: ""

imagePullSecrets: []
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

serviceAccount:
  # Specifies whether a service account should be created
  create: true
  # Annotations to add to the service account
  annotations: {}
  # The name of the service account to use.
  # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template
  name: ""

podAnnotations: {}
podLabels: {}

podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 1001
  runAsUser: 1001
  runAsGroup: 1001
  runAsNonRoot: true

securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80
  targetPort: 5000

ingress:
  enabled: false
  className: ""
  annotations: {}

  tls: []
